ut-ltg-2026-state-general-certification.agency: Utah Office of the Lieutenant Governor, Office of Elections
ut-ltg-2026-state-general-certification.title: ***AMENDED*** 2026 General Election Certification (signed 2026-09-21): Utah Senate, Utah House of Representatives, State Board of Education, judicial retention
ut-ltg-2026-state-general-certification.note: A signed scan read through its machine-read text layer. It prints candidate and party only, and says its order is the ballot order. Every name matched to the office's typed Candidate Filings page in the same race and party, whose spelling is kept (4 names matched by race and party where machine reading had misread a letter). A race's county_ids are the counties its heading sentence names (2 heading(s) with a county name misread by one letter). Retention: 32 state-court judges loaded, and 30 of the 30 justice-court questions (county and city courts): for those, only the judge's name and the court are read, the name is the scan's own reading because the filings page has no table of them, the court is matched to a county or to a city or town on the Census Bureau's place list (1 name(s) with one letter misread), and the group is read twice and its 30 answer lines counted. The 2 proposed constitutional amendments are not loaded. Withdrawn, disqualified or deceased, left off: 40. Out at a party convention, not on any ballot: 49. The certification prints no contact columns.

local_calendar.t: On November 3, 2026 Utah's counties elect the county officers whose four-year terms end this year (as a rule, commission or council seats and the county clerk, auditor, sheriff and attorney), local school boards elect about half their members, special districts on the even-year cycle fill board seats, and justice court judges whose terms end face a yes or no retention vote. City and town offices, and special districts on the municipal cycle, are elected in November of odd-numbered years, next in 2027. The county treasurer, recorder, surveyor and assessor are, as a rule, on the other four-year cycle, next in 2028.
local_calendar.s: Utah Code 20A-1-201 and 20A-1-202 (what each November election fills), 17-66-202 (county officers' terms), 20A-14-202 (local school boards), 17B-1-306 (special districts) and 78A-7-203 (justice court judges)

local_coverage.t: Loaded for Utah's local level so far: the justice court judges' retention questions on the Lieutenant Governor's amended General Election Certification (30 of them, for county and city courts alike), filed with the other judges and tied to the counties where those courts sit (17 of the 29). Not loaded yet: county offices and local school board contests, which each county clerk certifies and posts for the county alone, and special district boards. Ballot questions are not loaded: the proposed constitutional amendments and local propositions.
local_coverage.s: Utah Office of the Lieutenant Governor, Office of Elections: 2026 General Election Certification, signed 2026-09-21
